evidence.quote: If an unauthorized user gets a copy of this token, they will be able to access all Smartsheet data that you have access to, both to read and modify on your behalf.
You can generate access tokens in the Smartsheet UI.
Required plan: Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management
The email address used to register for Developer Tools must belong to an existing licensed Smartsheet user on a Business plan or higher.
Unlock the power of AI by connecting Smartsheet with Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI clients through the Smartsheet MCP (Model Context Protocol) server.
Required plan: Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management

result.notes: API and official MCP server both gated behind Business/Enterprise/Advanced Work Management plans; no free-tier credential path exists. Free trial accounts explicitly cannot generate API access tokens.
result.one_liner: Smartsheet is a work management/collaboration platform (sheets, projects, workflows) with a REST API and official MCP server.
